name: Jamahkiri Dive Resort & Spa
zone: Thian Og Bay (Shark Bay / Haad Tien), south Koh Tao

rooms.type: Deluxe Room (AC, hotel wing, sea-view balcony) — realistic street rate; official rack ฿9,400
Deluxe Pavilion (standalone Thai-antique pavilion, wooden floor, sea view); rack ฿11,400
Deluxe Suite Pavilion (bedroom + living room, private balcony); rack ฿14,900
Pool Villa / Royal Suite (1-3 bedroom, private pool/penthouse); rack ฿30,000

highlights: The closest thing Koh Tao has to a true luxury resort — Balinese-style hillside villas and pavilions cascading down a headland with panoramic sea views over Thian Og (Shark) Bay
Cliff-top pool with a poolside bar and sweeping azure Gulf views, widely called one of the best resort pools on the island
Direct access to a private snorkelling cove/house reef right below the resort — good snorkelling straight off the property
Large full-service Jamahkiri Spa (Swedish massage, aloe-vera body wraps, facials) plus a fitness room and viewpoint restaurant
On-site SSI/PADI dive centre with small-group teaching (around 2 students per instructor) and its own marina/boat
Excellent breakfast, genuinely warm and attentive staff, and a MICHELIN Guide hotel listing; operating since 2002, Green Leaf member
cons: Built into a very steep hillside — a huge number of stairs between rooms, pool and restaurant; exhausting and unsuitable for guests with mobility issues
Remote south-coast setting: the pier shuttle runs only about 3 times a day, otherwise you rely on pricey taxis, and it's far from Sairee Beach nightlife/restaurants
Recurring guest complaints about faulty/underpowered air-conditioning and general maintenance, and on-site dining is expensive versus town restaurants
Rooms and decor feel somewhat dated for a property marketed as 5-star luxury; value is debated at higher published rates
notes:
CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026): official site live (jamahkiri.com), MICHELIN Guide hotel page, Booking.com 8.3/10 from 1,411 verified reviews, TripAdvisor 4.4/5 ranked #10 of 52 Koh Tao hotels (1,343 reviews). Opened 2002; 36 air-conditioned rooms/pavilions/villas — this is an AC luxury property, NOT basic fan-only bungalows.

LOCATION CORRECTION to the brief: the resort is on the headland of Thian Og Bay (Ao Thian Ok), aka Shark Bay / near Haad Tien on the SOUTH/southeast coast — not Ao Jansom/Chalok as stated. Official site and reviews both confirm 'Thian Og Bay overlooking Shark Bay'. About a 10-minute drive over the hill from Mae Haad pier.

GETTING THERE (Koh Tao-specific): no airport on the island — arrive by high-speed catamaran/ferry (Lomprayah, Songserm, Seatran Discovery) to Mae Haad pier from Chumphon (~1.5-2h, the fastest mainland gateway), Surat Thani, or hopping down from Koh Samui / Koh Phangan. Then a taxi or songthaew ~10 min over the ridge to Thian Og Bay. Resort offers free pier transfers but the shuttle only runs ~3x daily; otherwise island taxis are pricey. Monsoon season (roughly Oct-Dec) can make the ferry crossing rough or lead to cancellations — build in buffer days.

PRICING: official published/rack rates are high (Deluxe ฿9,400, Pavilion ฿11,400, Suite Pavilion ฿14,900, Royal Suite ฿30,000) but real booking-engine/OTA prices are far lower — h-rez lists 'from THB3,510', KAYAK ~$114, TripAdvisor deals ~$71-93. Realistic cheapest standard AC room ≈ ฿3,500/night; room prices given are approximate street rates with rack rate noted alongside.

SCORES: Booking 8.3/10 (verified). Agoda and Trip.com numeric scores could not be confirmed from accessible pages (both listings exist and are live — Agoda: agoda.com/jamahkiri-spa-resort/hotel/koh-tao-th.html; Trip.com id 709189) so left blank rather than fabricated. Photos: official site jamahkiri.com has extensive real photography; Oyster.com also has an on-site photo review. All URLs above were actually seen in search/fetch results — none fabricated.

VIBE: upscale dive-and-spa retreat for couples/divers wanting seclusion, sunsets and a spa over Sairee's party scene; trade-off is the stairs and isolation.

name: Haadtien Beach Resort (The Haad Tien Beach Resort)
zone: Haad Tien / Shark Bay (Ao Thian Ok), secluded southeast tip of Koh Tao
highlights: Own 380m secluded white-coral beach on Shark Bay (Ao Thian Ok) with genuinely excellent snorkeling right off the sand
70 spacious private villas spread across 45+ acres of palm groves for real seclusion and privacy
Two outdoor pools, two poolside bars and the InSea beach bar & grill with standout ocean-view breakfast
Consistently praised, friendly staff and a calm, tranquil away-from-the-crowds atmosphere
Full-service Tien Spa for aromatherapy and massage after snorkeling or kayaking
Free shuttle/taxi-boat service to Mae Haad pier and Sairee town, easing the remote location
cons: Remote: ~20 min by taxi (or 25 min by taxi-boat) over steep hills from Mae Haad pier, and you need transport to reach Sairee town/nightlife
Some villas feel dated/tired for a 4-star price point, with noisy older AC units reported
Pricey relative to Koh Tao's many budget dive-hostel alternatives
Inconsistent housekeeping and occasional room-category mix-ups noted in recent reviews; Booking.com score (7.3) trails Agoda/Trip.com
notes: CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2026 prices/reviews live across Booking, Agoda, Trip.com, TripAdvisor, official haadtien.com). Located at Thian Og Bay / Shark Bay (Ao Thian Ok) on the secluded SE tip of Koh Tao, Surat Thani. Official site markets ~9 villa categories (Hideaway, Getaway, Getaway Signature, Haadtien, Castaway Beach, Castaway Beach Family, Haadtien Pool, Getaway Family Pool, Castaway Beachfront Pool 1BR/2BR); these are AC design villas, NOT fan-only backpacker bungalows. Prices above are approximate ranges — official site shows no fixed rates; USD aggregators show cheapest from ~$80-90 (~฿3,000-3,300), so ฿3,200 entry is realistic (rack spikes to $200+/villa in peak). GETTING THERE: catamaran (Lomprayah/Songserm) from Chumphon, Surat Thani, Koh Samui or Koh Phangan to Mae Haad pier, then ~20-min taxi/songthaew or a 25-min taxi-boat over steep hills to the bay; resort runs a shuttle. Monsoon (esp. Oct-Dec) can make the Gulf crossing rough or cause ferry cancellations. SCORES verified: Agoda 8.2 (~2,395 reviews), Trip.com 8.8 (76 reviews), TripAdvisor 4.0/5 ranked #5-6 of 52 Koh Tao hotels (2,768 reviews), Booking.com ~7.3/10 (~948 reviews) — Booking notably lower, so I report it but flagged the gap. Reviews are polarized (5-star tranquility praise vs 1-star maintenance complaints). Photo source = official villas page; TripAdvisor/Trip.com galleries also carry many real guest photos.

name: Koh Tao Heights Pool Villas
zone: Sairee Beach (North Sairee hillside), Koh Tao

rooms.type: Sea View Pool Villa (standard, ~120 sqm, private infinity pool + jacuzzi, AC bedroom + ceiling fan)
Treetop Villa (highest/most private, jungle + sea framing)
Infinity Villa (elevated cliff-side, wide Sairee Bay view)
Horizon Villa (top of the cliff, best panoramic Sairee Bay + Koh Nang Yuan view)

highlights: Jaw-dropping panoramic views over Sairee Bay and Koh Nang Yuan from every villa's infinity pool
Large (~120 sqm) fully private villas each with its own 6m x 3m infinity pool, jacuzzi, sundeck and gazebo
Highly responsive, attentive staff (reachable via WhatsApp) who arrange taxis, scooter rentals, dive/snorkel trips and food delivery
Peaceful, adults-focused hillside seclusion yet only about a 2-minute drive (or ~10-min walk) down to Sairee's restaurants, bars and beach
Ranked #1 of 176 specialty lodging on Koh Tao with a 4.9/5 TripAdvisor rating over 277 reviews
Spacious villas combining traditional Thai and modern design, with separate living area, kitchen/pantry, 50-inch TV and AC bedroom
cons: Very steep hillside access - the road up is challenging, so guests are advised to use the villa taxi (about 250 THB) rather than walk uphill with luggage
Requires reasonable physical fitness; lots of steps and inclines around the property make it unsuitable for guests with mobility issues
Air-conditioning noted by some guests as inconsistent (either very cold or off) in parts of the villa
Open, nature-immersed design means occasional tropical wildlife visitors (geckos, ants, birds) inside the villas
notes:
CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026). Located at 49/3 Moo 1, Sairee Village, North Sairee hillside, Koh Tao, Surat Thani 84360. This is the top-end pool-villa product on the island: private-pool, adults-oriented villas set high on the cliff above Sairee with views over Sairee Bay and Koh Nang Yuan. Note the property has a SISTER property, 'Koh Tao Heights Boutique Villas' (TripAdvisor d2706219) - a separate, more basic villa product under the same brand - do not conflate the two; this review is the Pool Villas (d4916187).

Scores: Booking.com 8.7/10 (couples), TripAdvisor 4.9/5 over 277 reviews (#1 of 176 specialty lodging on Koh Tao). Agoda and Trip.com detail pages exist and were located but their live guest-score numbers could not be scraped (both sites returned bot-blocks: Agoda served only chrome, Trip.com returned HTTP 418), so scoreAgoda/scoreTrip are left blank rather than invented - verify on-page when publishing.

Pricing: no fan-vs-AC distinction applies here - every unit is a full AC private-pool villa (this is not a fan-bungalow property). Realistic entry ~5,500-6,500 THB/night low season for a standard Sea View Pool Villa, rising to roughly 9,000-14,000+ THB in high season; premium cliff-top villas (Horizon, Infinity) command the top of the range. TripAdvisor showed an average nightly band of about USD 228-338 (~8,000-12,000 THB), and one aggregator flagged season deals 'from $181' (~6,300 THB). Named villa types referenced across sources: Horizon, Infinity, Treetop, plus Oasis/Mirage/Adoro/Aristo.

Getting there (Koh Tao specifics for the review): no airport on Koh Tao - reach the island by high-speed catamaran to Mae Haad pier (Lomprayah or Songserm) from Chumphon (~1.5-2 hrs) or from Surat Thani/Koh Samui/Koh Phangan (Samui ~1.5-2 hrs, Phangan ~1-1.5 hrs); nearest airport is Koh Samui (~40 miles away, then ferry). From Mae Haad pier take a songthaew/taxi north to Sairee, then the villa's own taxi up the steep private road. Ferries can be rough or cancelled in the monsoon (roughly Oct-Dec), so build in buffer days. Dive-resort island vibe - most guests come to dive/snorkel, and the resort coordinates dive trips.

Official site kohtaoheights.com is live (indexed, real villa photos at /pool-villas/) but its host DNS timed out from this environment on direct fetch - use it as the primary real-photo source when building the page.

name: Ban's Diving Resort
highlights: Home to a PADI 5-Star Career & Instructor Development Centre (est. 1993), long billed as the most-certifying dive centre in the world - top-tier scuba instruction and strong value on courses
Sprawling beachfront 'village' spread across central Sairee: 4 swimming pools, lush gardens, gym, spa/hair salon, dive shop, 24-hour mini-marts and on-site ATMs
Direct Sairee Beach frontage with a beach restaurant, Coffee House & Pool Bar and the Fish Bowl bar - sunset views and live music most nights
Ranked #1 of 52 Koh Tao hotels on TripAdvisor (4.6/5 from 6,700+ reviews); staff repeatedly praised as friendly and helpful
Excellent central location - walkable to Sairee's bars, restaurants and shops, with easy taxi and dive-trip arrangement
Wide room range from cheap fan bungalows and dorm beds up to air-con pool-view rooms, so it suits both backpacker divers and comfort seekers
cons: The property is split by a busy through-road with no dedicated crossing - guests must wait to cross to reach reception, breakfast and the beach side
Inconsistent room quality: some rooms sit up a very steep hill, and the cheaper fan bungalows are basic and dated
Booking.com guest score is only 7.6/10 - recurring complaints of cold-water showers, occasional hygiene/pool-maintenance issues and noise
Large and impersonal - at peak season it can feel like a diving factory, with crowds and late-night noise from the beach bars
notes:
CONFIRMED real and operating in 2025-2026: TripAdvisor lists 'Updated 2026 Prices', official PADI 5-Star CDC site (bansdivingresort.com) is live, and OTAs show current availability. Location: central Sairee Beach, Koh Tao, Surat Thani. Getting there: high-speed catamaran (Lomprayah / Songserm) from Chumphon (~1.5-2h), Surat Thani, Koh Samui or Koh Phangan to Mae Haad pier, then a short songthaew/taxi to Sairee (~5-10 min); ferries can be rough or cancelled in the Oct-Dec monsoon.

Scores verified: Booking.com 7.6/10 from 2,293 reviews; Trip.com 8.5/10 (44 reviews, hotel-detail-709169); TripAdvisor #1 of 52, 4.6/5 (6,742 reviews); Hotels.com 8.0/10 (394 reviews). Agoda listing exists (agoda.com/ban-s-diving-resort/hotel/koh-tao-th.html) but I could NOT extract a confirmed Agoda numeric score - Agoda/Booking detail pages are JS-rendered and returned empty via WebFetch, so scoreAgoda left blank rather than invented.

Pricing: THB room prices are ESTIMATES converted from OTA USD figures (rates from ~$18 dorm/budget, typical ~$48-71/night standard AC). Owner's ~฿700 fan-bungalow floor is consistent. Exact per-room-type THB not scraped from a live rate table - treat the room prices as approximate. Amenities confirmed via multiple sources: 4 pools, Fish Bowl bar, beach restaurant + Darawan restaurant, Coffee House/Pool Bar, spa & salon, Ban's Gym, conservation centre, 2 mini-marts, ATMs. Note: 'star rating' set to 4 (Booking classifies it 4-star); it is really a large dive-focused resort, not a boutique luxury property.

URLs above were all seen in search results; official accommodation page (photoSourceUrl) and OTA detail pages are the real listings, though the official site body is JS-loaded.

name: Sensi Paradise Beach Resort
highlights: One of the best-located non-dive stays on Koh Tao: a private Mae Haad beachfront, a short walk from the ferry pier, village shops and restaurants
A charming 40-ish room resort of locally-built wooden bungalows set through lush tropical gardens, giving real character over generic hotel blocks
Two swimming pools plus a well-liked beachfront restaurant with sunset Gulf views
Genuinely calm, couples- and family-friendly atmosphere away from Sairee’s party scene, while still walkable to the action
Consistently solid guest scores (Booking.com 8.3 from ~1,700 reviews), repeatedly praised for location, gardens and friendly staff
cons: Mid-range pricing (from ~฿3,000), not a backpacker-budget option like Koh Tao’s many dive hostels
Wooden bungalows are charming but can feel basic/older in places; upkeep varies by room
Mae Haad is the pier/village beach — fine for a swim and sunsets but not Koh Tao’s finest sand or snorkeling (Tanote/Nang Yuan are better for that)
The pier area can be busy with ferry arrivals and boat traffic during the day
notes: Swapped in for Crystal Dive (which is a dive-school selling rooms direct-only, no OTA hotel listing). Sensi Paradise verified live on Agoda/Booking/Trip; Booking 8.3/10 (~1,736 reviews). Mae Haad beachfront, ~40 wooden garden bungalows, 2 pools, beachfront restaurant, walkable to pier/village. Realistic cheapest garden bungalow ~฿2,900-3,300 (rack from 3,300, OTA low-season dips ~2,000). Access: catamaran (Lomprayah/Songserm/Seatran) to Mae Haad pier from Chumphon/Surat Thani/Koh Samui/Koh Phangan, resort is a short walk from the pier.

name: Chintakiri Resort

rooms.type: Deluxe Bungalow (garden / partial view, AC) - low-season promo
Deluxe Sea-View Bungalow (tropical wood, AC, private terrace)

highlights: Spectacular unobstructed sea views over Chalok Baan Kao from nearly every terraced bungalow
Well-maintained infinity/outdoor pool in a scenic elevated position - a repeated standout in reviews
Consistently praised, attentive service (guests describe it as near '5-star' care for a 3-star resort)
19 tropical-wood deluxe bungalows with proper air-conditioning, spacious clean bathrooms and private balconies - a step above Koh Tao's typical fan-only backpacker huts
Quiet, romantic, non-party setting on the calmer south end of the island, ~200 m from Chalok beach and close to Shark Bay/Freedom Beach
On-site restaurant, bar and coffee shop with good, reasonably priced food and free WiFi throughout
cons: Built up a very steep hillside with many flights of stairs - hard with heavy luggage and unsuitable for guests with mobility issues
Somewhat remote/elevated location: you realistically need a scooter or taxi to get around, and feel 'stuck' without transport
Some guests find it a bit overpriced for Koh Tao and note certain facilities/rooms could use refurbishment
Slow breakfast service and occasional booking/room-availability hiccups mentioned in a minority of reviews
notes:
CONFIRMED real and operating in 2025-2026 (live listings on Booking, Agoda, Trip.com, Expedia, Hotels.com; official site chintakiriresort.top). Location: 19/59-77 Moo 3, Chalok Baan Kao, Koh Tao 84360, on the quieter south end of the island - ~200 m from Chalok Baan Kao beach, ~600 m from Shark Bay, ~1.1 km from Freedom Beach. Property is 19-21 tropical-wood deluxe bungalows terraced up a steep hillside with sea views and an elevated pool; AC rooms (not fan-only), so it's a polished boutique rather than a dive-hostel. Getting there (Koh Tao specifics): no airport - take a Lomprayah or Songserm catamaran to Mae Haad pier from Chumphon (~1.5-2 hr, closest mainland), Surat Thani, Koh Samui or Koh Phangan, then a songthaew/taxi south to Chalok (~10-15 min up the hill). Ferries can be rough or cancelled in the Oct-Dec monsoon, so build in buffer days. It is a non-dive boutique - no on-site dive shop - but plenty of PADI schools are a short ride away in Mae Haad/Sairee.

RATINGS (verified July 2026): Booking.com 8.7/10 (couples score); Agoda ~8.8/10 (HotelsCombined aggregation shows 8.8 from ~392 reviews - confirm the exact live Agoda number on the detail page before publishing, it was not directly scrapeable); TripAdvisor 4.4/5 from ~497 reviews, ranked #13 of ~52 Koh Tao hotels. NOTE: the brief's known context (TA #12, 4.0/5, 494 reviews) is slightly stale - the current TripAdvisor page reads 4.4/5, 497 reviews, #13. I could NOT independently verify a Trip.com numeric score (Trip.com returned HTTP 418 and Agoda page returned only chrome) so scoreTrip left blank rather than fabricated - pull it live before publishing.

PRICING: rates vary widely by season. Aggregators show averages around $70/night (~฿2,500), lows around $38-$50 (~฿1,300-1,800) in shoulder months (Oct/March cited as cheapest), and headline 'from' rates up to $102 in peak. A realistic cheapest standard AC deluxe bungalow sits around ฿1,900 low-season / ฿2,800 sea-view high-season. Extra bed ฿900/person/night. Treat the room prices above as approximate season-dependent estimates, not quoted rates. Phone: +66 77 456 391.

URLs above are real detail pages I actually reached or saw in search results. Official site chintakiriresort.top and the Booking.com listing both carry genuine resort photos (pool, sea-view bungalows, restaurant).

name: Sairee Cottage Resort
highlights: Genuinely beachfront in the heart of Sairee Beach — step straight onto the sand, walkability 100/100, dozens of restaurants, bars and dive shops within a 5-minute stroll
Two swimming pools including one with a lively swim-up bar, plus an on-site PADI 5-star dive centre (Sairee Cottage Diving) so you can train and stay in one place
Beachfront restaurant/bar with famous sunset views, Thai and Western dishes, BBQ, and a beloved homemade ice-cream/bakery shop open till late
Standout value — a 4-star-quality beachfront room here typically runs far below the Koh Tao average, with guests repeatedly saying 'for the money it's excellent'
Lush tropical garden setting and warm, helpful local staff — one repeat guest called it their favourite Koh Tao stay for over 20 years
Free shuttle to the boat pier and steps from longtail/snorkel boats to Koh Nang Yuan, making dive and island-hopping logistics effortless
cons: Room quality varies a lot by category — the cheapest fan bungalows are basic, small, with minimal storage and furniture; pay up for AC/poolside/beachfront
Noise from the adjacent Sairee walking street, bars and the late-night ice-cream parlour can carry into rooms closest to the front
Some 2026 guests complained of strict house rules and stiff damage/breakage charges at check-out
Fan-only bungalows get hot and humid in the low season — worth confirming AC before booking if you feel the heat
notes: Confirmed REAL and operating (2025-2026) via official site saireecottageresort.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Traveloka, Hotels.com and TripAdvisor. Locally owned, ~40 rooms, directly on Sairee Beach — Koh Tao's main/most vibrant bay. TripAdvisor 4.2/5 (895 reviews), ranked #5 of ~176 specialty lodging in Koh Tao; aggregators show ~8.8-8.9/10 (HotelsCombined 8.9 from 1,264 reviews); Trip.com listed 8.8 (35 reviews) in one view and 7.8 (44 reviews) in another. Star rating is effectively ~3-star (some OTAs badge it 4-star for its facilities). Distinct from — but co-located and affiliated with — 'Sairee Cottage Diving', the PADI 5-star dive school (accommodation is sold as the resort's bungalows/'diver rooms'). Room count 17 named categories on the official site incl. Beachfront, Family Beachfront, Standard, Triple, Fan, Garden Room, Poolside/Double/Triple Poolside; overall OTA price band roughly $19-$131 (~฿700-฿4,700). ROOM PRICES ARE APPROXIMATE (derived from OTA $ ranges + the ~฿700 fan-bungalow floor), not live quotes — verify with dates. GETTING THERE: no airport pier direct; take a high-speed catamaran (Lomprayah or Songserm) to Mae Haad pier — from Chumphon (~1.5-2h), Koh Samui (~1.5-2h), Koh Phangan (~1-1.5h), or Surat Thani (bus+boat combo); then a short songthaew/taxi (or the resort's free shuttle) north to Sairee. Ferries can be rough or cancelled in the Oct-Dec monsoon/big-swell periods. NO genuine Booking.com/hotel/th detail page was found — Booking.com searches returned the different 'Sairee Hut Resort' (booking.com/hotel/th/saireehut-resort.html), so bookingUrl and scoreBooking are intentionally left blank rather than fabricated. Other real detail pages seen: Traveloka (sairee-cottage-resort-3000010020151), Hotels.com (ho3430089376), Agoda reviews page (/sairee-cottage-resort-sha-plus/reviews/ko-tao-th.html), Facebook (facebook.com/saireecottagekohtao). Real photos available on the official site and its Facebook page.

name: Mountain Reef Beach Resort

rooms.type: Fan hillside bungalow / hut (budget, sea-view balcony)
Deluxe Triple Room Sea View (air-con, balcony)
Family Room Beachfront (fan, steps from the water)

highlights: Direct reef access — snorkel straight off the beach in Tanote Bay, widely rated the island's best snorkeling, with abundant fish, healthy coral and turtle sightings
Beachfront bungalows perched on the rocks just a few metres from the water, plus cheaper huts set into the hillside forest with sweeping views over the whole bay
On-site restaurant serving Thai and Western food with a standout view over the bay — praised for quality and setting
Genuinely secluded, peaceful, crowd-free location on one of Koh Tao's most remote east-coast beaches — ideal for switching off
Friendly, helpful family-run staff who arrange transfers, snorkel/dive trips and local tips
Clean, spacious rooms with sea views; AC rooms include TV and refrigerator — good comfort for a remote bay
cons: Remote bay — no walkable town; a taxi/songthaew runs to Mae Haad pier only about twice a day (~฿100/person) and the road over the hill is steep, so you're fairly tied to the resort
Beachfront is gravel and broken coral rather than soft sand, with occasional algae/debris — great for snorkeling, less so for lounging
Prices run notably higher than comparable Koh Tao bungalows (high-season beachfront rooms can hit ~฿5,900), and value-for-money scores lag
Basic, dated furnishings in places — hard beds, worn linens, sparse balconies; the cheaper fan huts are simple with mosquito nets
notes:
CONFIRMED real and operating in 2025-2026 (live listings with 2026 pricing on Booking, Agoda, Trip.com, TripAdvisor, KAYAK). Address: 40/9 Tanote Bay, Koh Tao, Surat Thani 84360, ~1.6 mi from Mae Haad pier. Best-regarded stay on Tanote Bay, matching the known context.

Scores: Booking ~8.3 (task context; aggregators showed 8.2/149 and 8.5 'recent guests' — all cluster low-to-mid 8s). TripAdvisor 4.0/5 (~63 reviews), ranked ~#45/176 specialty lodging on Koh Tao. Agoda and Trip.com detail pages returned bot-blocks (HTTP 418 / empty render) so I could not read their exact numeric scores — left blank rather than invent. Star rating ~3 (aggregators list ⋆⋆⋆).

Pricing: cheapest fan hillside huts realistically ~฿1,000-1,400/night low season; standard AC double ~฿1,900-2,300; deluxe triple sea-view AC ~฿2,800-3,200; beachfront fan family bungalows ~฿3,500-4,000, spiking to ~฿5,900 in high season. USD aggregators showed roughly $76-95/night typical, from $50 in November low season, so THB figures are estimates converted/cross-checked — treat as approximate, not scraped rack rates.

Getting there (Koh Tao specifics): fly/train to Chumphon or Surat Thani (or come from Koh Samui / Koh Phangan), then Lomprayah or Songserm catamaran to Mae Haad pier; from Mae Haad it's a ~15-20 min songthaew/taxi over a steep hill to Tanote Bay (resort runs a shared taxi ~twice daily, ~฿100/person). Monsoon (roughly Oct-Dec) can bring rough seas and ferry cancellations. Dive/snorkel-resort vibe; fan-only rooms and simple bungalow basics on the budget tier; remote east-coast bay means you rely on the resort restaurant and scheduled taxis.
